name: print-social-black-story-mockups-of-autonomous-vans-with-light-captions
title: Three Instagram stories on black: a man hailing the van, 'AI drives. You relax.' and parked vans in a city
whatItIs: A black board with an outlined 'STORIES EXAMPLE' pill and three story frames with a lime avatar 'Pilotaxi', progress bars and message bars: a man checking a lime app beside a white van, a van driving toward the camera with 'AI drives. You relax.' in thin white type and a sub line, and two vans parked among glass towers.
whatItMeans: Clean and futuristic; photography with one thin headline makes ads feel like content.
techniques: Put a single thin headline in one story.
Use a lime avatar as the only colour.

vocabulary.definition: The progress bars, avatar and message bar around a story.
Light-weight type for a calm message.
Three frames telling a mini narrative.
A coloured profile icon in the story header.
